# Solution Intake

Follow the governed [solution-intake procedure](../../../skills/solution-intake/SKILL.md).

Before starting:

1. Read `standards/intake-and-triage.md`.
2. Use the references under `skills/solution-intake/reference/`.
3. Use `templates/solution-intake.md` for the generated brief.
4. If the input is a SharePoint URL, verify an approved authenticated tool can list and read the folder. If not, stop with a setup or permission error.
5. Never treat an inaccessible document as reviewed.

Stop after the intake disposition and request explicit developer approval before architecture.
